layer: host virtualization API and QEMU device model
scope: Bounded public host-interface survey; no private node identity inference and no new runtime experiment

interfaces.name: VZMacPlatformConfiguration / VZMacHardwareModel
interfaces.mechanism: opaque compatible platform identity and auxiliary storage

interfaces.name: VZVirtualMachineConfiguration
interfaces.version: macOS 11.0+; individual properties have their own availability

interfaces.name: VZCustomVirtioDevice
interfaces.mechanism: custom PCI/Virtio device, queues and host delegate; documented for Linux guests
interfaces.reason: No identity or transport match to current recovery firmware access

interfaces.name: PGDevice
interfaces.mechanism: host implementation of specifically advertised GPU MMIO
interfaces.reason: Four-byte access match alone cannot identify an unknown device as graphics

interfaces.name: QEMU ARM apple-gfx-mmio adapter
interfaces.mechanism: known graphics MMIO forwarded to native framework
interfaces.reason: ARM extension declarations are absent from distributed framework headers per source; target correspondence not established

interfaces.name: Hypervisor framework / hv_vm_map
interfaces.mechanism: host memory and vCPU exits for an independently owned VMM
interfaces.reason: Generic VMM mechanism, no target device semantics or existing VZVirtualMachine hook

interfaces.name: QEMU MemoryRegionOps
interfaces.mechanism: host MMIO callbacks with width, alignment and transaction constraints
interfaces.reason: Dispatch API supplies no target reset/read/side-effect values

interfaces.name: vhost-user
interfaces.version: live QEMU master docs retrieved 2026-09-07; wire header version 1
interfaces.reason: No matching guest frontend or target register protocol

interfaces.name: VZ machine state restoration
interfaces.version: macOS 14 sample workflow; live API reference
interfaces.mechanism: framework-produced whole-VM saved state compatible with configuration
interfaces.reason: No documented per-device state interchange into QEMU

existing_runtime_evidence.source: BP14 same-event transaction and BP16 Build Plan

implementation_resume_requires: host API lifecycle and serialization if a host service is required
